items.t: Oil sludge and engine failure (2.7L)
items.job: Replace engine with a used 2.7L V6
items.note: Price assumes a used engine; a new or remanufactured engine costs more. Caught early, a cooling system fix may be enough.

items.t: Stalls right after refueling
items.job: Replace fuel tank vent/control valve assembly
items.note: Often covered by Chrysler's extended fuel tank coverage. Ask a dealer and check your VIN first.

items.t: Early front suspension and tie rod wear
items.job: Replace front tension struts and tie rod ends, then align
items.note: Cost depends on how many joints are worn. Ball joints or control arms add to the bill.

items.t: Takata air bag inflators (do-not-drive recall)
items.note: Free under the Takata recall. Check your VIN and ask the dealer for a tow or mobile repair.

items.t: Rear brake lines can wear through (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake lines and bleed brakes
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN before paying for this repair.

items.t: ABS software can lock the rear brakes (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Drive wheels can briefly lock during shifts (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Rear axle hub nuts can loosen (recall)
items.job: Replace and torque rear axle hub nuts
items.note: Covered by recall. If the hub or axle was damaged, cost goes up.

items.t: Key can stick between Start and On and stall (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Front spindle nut may be missing (recall)
items.job: Install and torque front spindle nut
items.note: Covered by recall. A damaged hub or bearing would add cost.

items.t: Key can be removed when not in Park (recall)
items.job: Repair shifter and ignition park interlock
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: HEMI lifter tick and camshaft wear
items.note: If metal has spread through the engine, a replacement engine costs much more.

items.t: Broken exhaust manifold bolts (HEMI)
items.job: Extract broken bolts and replace manifold gasket
items.note: Price is per side. Bolts that snap and must be drilled out add time.

items.t: Sudden alternator failure (recalls)
items.note: Some years are covered by an alternator recall. Check your VIN or ask the dealer first.

items.t: Left cylinder head valve seat wear (3.6L)
items.note: A Chrysler warranty extension covered this but has likely expired. Still ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Oil filter housing leak (3.6L)
items.job: Replace oil filter housing and oil cooler assembly
items.note: Use the updated aluminum-style housing. Coolant may need to be refilled too.

items.t: Overheated power center can disable ABS and stability control (recall)
items.job: Replace ABS fuse/relay and inspect power center
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Headlamp wiring can overheat (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Side air bags can deploy unexpectedly (recall)
items.job: Update or replace side air bag control unit
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Connecting rod bearing failure (recall)
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured 3.6L
items.note: Covered by recall for affected engines. Check your VIN or ask the dealer before paying.

items.t: Shifter confusion and roll-away risk (recall)
items.job: Software update that adds Auto Park
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: AWD transmission output shaft can break (recall)
items.job: Replace transfer case output shaft parts
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Loose front driveshaft bolts on AWD (recall)
items.job: Replace and torque front driveshaft bolts
items.note: Covered by recall. A damaged driveshaft would add cost.

items.t: Cruise control may not turn off (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Fuel rail hose can leak (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Oil cooler hoses can burst (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Engine damage from oil loss would cost much more.

items.t: Engine computer voltage regulator can fail and stall (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Wrong park lock rod (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Side curtain air bag inflators can rupture (recall)
items.note: Price is per side. Free under recall; check your VIN.

items.t: Instrument cluster may not show warnings (recall)
items.note: Software update done free under recall. Check your VIN.

items.t: Windshield may not be bonded properly (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Low end is rebonding the old glass; high end includes new glass.

items.t: Shifter can slip out of Drive (recall)
items.job: Repair or replace gear shifter assembly
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.

items.t: Parking brake may not hold (recall)
items.note: Covered by recall. Check your VIN first.
